limits.title: Staff limits
limits.sub: Discount, export and what each role may see
limits.hint: A bigger discount than the limit goes to the owner for OK. Hidden phone and address show as “01•••••4521” and “Dhanmondi, Dhaka” — enough to pack, never enough to copy. Empty means no limit.
limits.packerText: A role with only packing and printing keys, whose phone and address are hidden.

handover.title: End-of-day cash & bKash handover
handover.sub: Counter cash and mobile wallet money each desk staff member took today
handover.on: Ask each desk staff member for a handover sheet
handover.written: Written. The sheet below is updated.
handover.off: The handover sheet is switched off. Turn it on above.
handover.empty: Nobody has handed over for this day yet.
handover.history: A newer count for the same day and money replaces the older one here; the older stays as history.

errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the numbers: amounts are whole numbers, percent is 0 to 100.
